pages.name: Akaishi Miner (9x9x3)
pages.text: The Akaishi Miner is a fixed $(bold)9x9x3$(0) multiblock: the bottom and top layers are cross-shaped frameworks with a Port at each center, while the middle layer holds only four framework pillars plus the controller.$(br2)F = Miner Framework, U = Miner Framework (Upgrade) — or an upgrade module — P = Miner Port, red block = controller. Keep the four corners hollow.

$(bold)Build order:$(0)$(li)Middle layer first: put four Framework pillars at the edge midpoints and the controller dead center (placing it early is fine — it detects the structure on its own)$(li)Bottom layer: one Port P at the very center, Framework F as the cross beams, Upgrade Frames U filling the ribs$(li)Top layer: mirror the bottom layer (Port at center too) — done$(br2)$(bold)Formed or not:$(0)the controller keeps checking automatically — $(c)break or misplace any block and the whole miner collapses$(0): upgrade counts reset, ports disconnect, digging freezes.$(br2)It reads like two floating cross-shaped decks with hollow corners — build it on open ground so you have room to add "$(l:akaishi:miner_upgrades)upgrade modules$(/l)" and route pipes later.
With the frame up, read on in order: pick a controller to set the "tier", then add "upgrade modules", then pipe power from the ports back into your grid.
